PC-IAC-015 MODULE RELEASE CONTRACT:
• Semantic Versioning: vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g. v1.2.0); git tags are immutable (never overwritten or moved)
• Public repository allows credential-free terraform init without leaking accounts, ARNs, or client data
• Infrastructure stacks consume modules strictly by pinned git tag (never branch or floating ref)
